closure_cl2.statement: S = 1 - p_pooled with p_pooled := P(wall | design) pooled over all 512 launches of the accepted-2N case (Jeffreys Beta posterior of the pooled counts)

Beta(s*w + 1/2, (n - s)*w + 1/2) with w = 1.0 (standard deviation ~ 1/sqrt(w) of the campaign posterior)
